GradeMIND — TRANSCRIPTION TEMPLATE
=================================================================
Copy this file to  golden/scripts/<SCRIPT_ID>/transcription.txt
then delete everything above the CUT line and type the answers.

You do not need to know anything about the software. You are typing
what is on the page, exactly as it is on the page.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
THE FOUR RULES
-----------------------------------------------------------------

1. TYPE IT VERBATIM. Keep the student's spelling, grammar and
   arithmetic exactly as written. Do not tidy anything.

     on the page:  "Photosynthesis makes there own food"
     you type:     Photosynthesis makes there own food
     NOT:          Photosynthesis makes their own food

   The misspelling is data. If the engine later mis-marks because of
   it, that is a real result and it must be in the record.

2. ONE HEADING PER QUESTION, on a line of its own, in square
   brackets: [Q1], [Q2], [Q4a]. Use the paper's own numbering.

3. USE ONLY THE FOUR MARKERS BELOW. Nothing else in brackets.

     (not attempted)   nothing written at all
     (illegible)       writing is there, you cannot read it
     (diagram)         a diagram you are not typing out

   (illegible) goes around the unreadable part only, inline —
   not the whole answer:

     the value of (illegible) is 9.8

   If the scheme gives marks for a diagram, describe it briefly:

     (diagram: ray diagram, converging lens, F marked)

4. DO NOT MARK ANYTHING. No marks, no ticks, no comments, no "[sic]",
   no corrections, no opinion on whether it is right. Marking is a
   separate step done by a separate person against the official
   scheme, and it happens AFTER this file is finished.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
EVERY QUESTION GETS A HEADING
-----------------------------------------------------------------

Including ones the student skipped. A missing heading and a
question answered with nothing are different statements, and
leaving the heading out will be rejected at intake.

-----------------------------------------------------------------
WHEN YOU ARE DONE
-----------------------------------------------------------------

Save as UTF-8. Then have someone run:

    python scripts/golden_intake.py golden/scripts/<SCRIPT_ID>

It will tell you exactly what is missing. It repairs nothing.
